# Preface {.unnumbered}

These notes cover energy balances for chemical engineering systems.
Topics include the first law of thermodynamics, enthalpy, and energy balances involving sensible heat changes, latent heat changes, and chemical reactions.

This book also contains examples, practice problems, and useful information including python based thermodynamic property calculators.

Useful slides are also available here: [Energy Balance Slides](https://marshall-echem-lab.github.io/thermo/energybalance-slides/)
